svg.title: ETL vs ELT — trip data flow and quality checkpoints
svg.desc: Extract monthly ZIP to raw; Spark transforms before load into silver Parquet and quarantine; COPY loads silver into PostgreSQL landing; dbt transforms after load into staging, intermediate, core and marts. Quality checkpoints DQ1 to DQ4.

text.tspan: ETL makes data technically correct · ELT makes it meaningful
Spark holds no business logic · dbt never touches file formats
